question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a brown present, Bob has a purple present, and Claire has a orange present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. Finally, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Bob has the
Options:
(A) brown present
(B) purple present
(C) orange present
solution:
Gift color order in each row: (Alice, Bob, Claire).
Initial: (brown, purple, orange)
1. Alice and Bob swap: (purple, brown, orange)
2. Alice and Bob swap: (brown, purple, orange)
3. Claire and Alice swap: (orange, purple, brown)
Bob has the purple present, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
